thread:
dina-partnerships: Quick heads up — Verge reported their marketplace totals were ~2% low for a rolling 72h. They suspect buffered uploader drops during poor cellular signal. Need a short reconciliation runbook + customer note.

omar-billing: Can we get a list of affected account_ids and an exposure estimate?

ryan-eng: Ran a rapid check. Pattern: missing sequence ranges in `uploader_events`. Rough count: ~1,580 hour-rows across 39 accounts.

leah-ops: Paste the detection query? ops can run a staged replay tonight if we get S3 bundles.

ryan-eng: Query: ```sql
SELECT account_id, hour, min(seq) as s, max(seq) as e, count(*)
FROM marketplace.uploader_events
WHERE partner='verge' AND created_at > now() - interval '96 hours'
GROUP BY account_id, hour
HAVING (e - s + 1) != count(*)
```

sam-liaison: Verge shipping firmware tweak tomorrow to stop dropping seq on cellular reconnects. They'll provide raw payload tarball.

omar-billing: Preliminary impact: ~2% => ~$2.9k monthly. Billing requires CSV with: account_id,hour,reported_tokens,corrected_tokens,delta,reason. Also need proof artifacts.

marketplace-bot: [automated] Created ticket #INC-2026-9981 and attached raw logs.

dina-partnerships: Draft customer line: "We detected a small omission in reported usage from Verge devices due to intermittent uploader drops. Redwood will reprocess and apply any necessary adjustments; no action required. Contact your account rep for details." Thoughts?

omar-billing: Good. Add: "Adjustments will be itemized and provided upon request." Legal OK?

dina-partnerships: I'll loop in legal and get a signoff. Action items: ryan -> produce S3 backfill bundle + manifest; leah -> schedule replay window 02:00-03:30 PT; omar -> prep adjustment CSV template; sam -> confirm Verge co-send.

ryan-eng: Will upload manifest to s3://redwood/backfills/verge/3795550123/ by 21:30 PT and tag this thread.

leah-ops: Ops ready for replay window; will wait for the manifest and billing signoff.

dina-partnerships: Thanks all — post updates here when ready.
